title: P1 kb.index_put: request
description: The ingest job of a corpus (kb.ingest.v1) writes the fragments of one document into the per-tenant corpus index in C1 (KNW-5, D-97). The core takes the corpus and the file from the leased ingest task: a request whose corpus or file differ from the task input, or whose file belongs to another tenant, gets forbidden and writes nothing; fragments of a curated corpus are written only for files that came through apply from git (KNW-4, KNW-2). A repeat for the same document replaces its fragments. The fragments are deleted together with the file (C1 file.purge); the built-in tools kb_search and kb_read read only this index.

corpus.description: Corpus id from the tenant catalog; it must equal the corpus of the leased ingest task.

file.description: The document file; it must equal the file of the leased ingest task.
